description: Restore the moving pictures. Test each horizontal drive: it may follow or reverse your hand. Compare HAND X with the destination square; no CLAMP is needed to learn the response. Use the visible carriage and turn controls to steer each fragment. When all rims are green, clamp all seams. Continue steering throughout the six-second closing seam. A bad clamp or a slipped seam ends the episode.
name: Parallax / Inertial Jigsaw Alignment V3 · Difficulty 3 · Simplified Interaction
natural_language: Test each horizontal drive before clamping: it may follow or reverse your hand. Compare HAND X with the destination square, then steer using the discovered direction. Track every moving aperture, then clamp all fragments and keep steering while the seam closes.
